title: Modifying screen brightness using brightnessctl should be instantly recognized by Plasma
line: Changing the laptop screen brightness with brightnessctl or another tool now updates Plasma's brightness slider and keyboard shortcuts.
explanation: PowerDevil already watches the backlight through udev and sends external changes to KWin as the device's observed brightness, but KWin only read that value when it first assigned the brightness device to an output. Every later update was stored and ignored, so the brightness setting, the slider and the brightness keys kept working from the old value. The change applies later observed-brightness updates to the output as both its brightness setting and current hardware brightness, so nothing is animated or written back; for laptop panels it first undoes the EDR headroom and dimming KWin applies to the backlight.

commits.message:
externalbrightness: apply observed brightness changes after setup

KWin only used a brightness device's observed brightness when it got
assigned, so backlight changes made with brightnessctl never reached the
setting. Later changes now update it, undoing EDR headroom and dimming.

BUG: 495381

media.caption: KWin integration test on an internal panel: a backlight change reported after setup (70 of 100) is ignored and the brightness setting stays at the old 50.
Same test with the fix: the internal panel's brightness setting follows the observed backlight value.
